mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_attachment a JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = a.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND a.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_attachment a JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = a.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND a.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND a.field_code = #{fieldCode}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_attachment (instance_id, task_id, round, field_code, file_name, file_size, file_ext, mime_type, storage_path, sha256, uploader_id) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{taskId}, IFNULL(#{round}, 0), #{fieldCode}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt}, #{mimeType}, #{storagePath}, #{sha256}, #{uploaderId})
